title.headline: 140 aircraft leases. One chronology per tail.

end.line: Quillon for Stroud Aviation’s leasing team

vo: Stroud Aviation’s leasing legal team manages one hundred and forty aircraft leases. Here is that work in Quillon.
Quillon builds the redelivery chronology for each tail number, and every event links back to its source document.
Vault reviews every lease and schedule at once, so return conditions come back flagged in one table.
Ask what a lease requires at redelivery, and the answer is cited to the page of the schedule.
Henrik will walk your team through it on Tuesday the twenty-fourth.
